description: We’re Mirrix, a team of four from Tashkent taking on the Martian Map challenge: one interactive map of Mars that combines NASA mission data so you can plan a safe walk and spot science worth studying. We care about clean design and a working demo. We have two spots open and want someone with maps/GIS or satellite data experience, a designer, or anyone with a space science background. If you’re curious about Mars and ready for 48 hours of work, message us.
